interface_mismatches: The exact sealed release 34bdaef620ff254244efdf32a22a73d6d48c48a2 completed AGNI's isolated build and inert standby publication, then the mandatory immediate deploy replay rejected with `runtime binding artifact self-digest differs`; Tailscale Serve remained empty and every authority unit remained inactive.

The staged-release admission deliberately computes `receipt_digest` over canonical JSON plus its persisted trailing newline, while the generic existing-receipt reader recomputed the default canonical JSON digest without that newline. Initial publication never traverses the existing-receipt validator, so the mismatch was invisible until the first real idempotent replay.

The repair must express the digest serialization domain as a narrow explicit validator parameter used only by staged-release admission. Exact persisted bytes, schema, UID/GID, regular-file mode, inode stability, admission projection equality, and every no-newline receipt remain unchanged and fail closed.
